info.title: CF Meet Developer Platform internal API
info.description: HTTP surface of services/developer-platform: GET /health, GET /ready, the service-authenticated /internal/v1 API and (cfmeet.developer-platform.http-api) the gateway-forwarded customer API under /v1. Every /internal/v1 path, unknown ones included, requires a valid Ed25519 service token whose issuer the Developer Platform's trust bundle grants the route's permission. Customers never reach this service directly: the API Gateway authenticates them (Platform Access credentials, or the CF Meet session verified through the Meeting Service bridge) and forwards a signed request. Section 53: POST /internal/v1/platform/events (developer-event.publish) ingests committed producer events for central customer webhooks, and the gateway-forwarded machine webhook API is served at Calling's public paths (/v1/webhooks*, /v1/webhook-deliveries/{delivery_id}/replay) for the cut-over. 1.5.0 Section 53 §9.1 / §19.3 webhook migration operator routes under /internal/v1/operator/webhook-migration/** (status, dry-run inventory, resumable import, reconcile, shadow report, cutover check, rotation acknowledgements, takeover, rollback export, rollback). 1.6.0 (Part VI Chapters 10–13): usage fact ingestion, stream watermarks and reconciliation (developer-event.publish), entitlement snapshots with caller restrictions, operator production-access decisions, overrides, first-party scope grants, usage operations, cost-centre usage, support profiles and the forwarded /v1/usage and /v1/limits.

post.description: Section 53: a producer (Meeting Service, Calling, Privacy Relay, Messaging, Numbering, SMS Gateway) publishes a committed domain event from its transactional outbox (platform envelope). Permission `developer-event.publish`; the envelope's producer_service must be the authenticated caller and its runtime_environment the receiver's; its type must belong to the producer's own domain (unknown families are refused). The event is projected into the public catalog (allow-listed safe keys only; never stored or forwarded verbatim), deduplicated on (producer, event_id) — a duplicate returns the same eventId and creates no delivery — and fanned out to the ACTIVE matching subscriptions of the SAME application environment (recorded SHADOW in shadow mode). 200 = accepted (also for internal-only facts, eventId null); 400 = refused (do not retry); 503 = retry later. Behind DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_WEBHOOKS_ENABLED (off: 404).

Requires webhooks.manage. Every subscribed event type also requires its own read scope (call.* calls.read, voicemail.* enterprise.voicemail.read, recording.* / artifact.* enterprise.recording.read, relay.* privacy.sessions.read, usage.* / limit.* usage.read, sms.* sms.read, conversation.* / message.* messages.read, number.* numbers.read, credential.* credentials.manage, production_access.* production_access.request; meeting.* / participant.* need webhooks.manage only). The endpoint must be a public https URL (re-checked at delivery and connection time; redirects never followed). The signing secret is returned ONCE. Machine credentials only (the console uses /v1/environments/{environmentId}/webhooks); scope (tenant, application, environment) is the credential's confirmed chain: another environment's subscription is 404. Gateway-forwarded: the API Gateway's service token (developer-request.forward) with the signed delegated context naming the authenticated credential; the public contract of this path is Calling's (cfmeet.calling.http-api, cfmeet.platform.webhooks) and the gateway re-points it here when API_GATEWAY_CENTRAL_WEBHOOKS_ENABLED. Behind DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_GATEWAY_API_ENABLED and DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_WEBHOOKS_ENABLED (off: 404).

post.description: Section 53 §9.1 / §19.3 webhook migration from Calling (operator tooling). Permission `developer-platform.administer` (operator console only) and a named human operator. Imports Calling's subscriptions, events, deliveries and attempts with their ids. Resumes the open run from its checkpoint (each page and its checkpoint commit together), else starts a full run; idempotent (upserts keyed by Calling's ids; a subscription is updated only when Calling's version is newer and it is unchanged here; a delivery still open at Calling is a held mirror). Signing secrets arrive only transfer-sealed and are re-sealed under this deployment's key ring; a secret that cannot be carried over makes the subscription ROTATION_REQUIRED (DISABLED, no secret) — never substituted. 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE without the transfer key, the key ring or CF_CALLING_BASE_URL. Audited.

post.description: Section 53 §9.1 / §19.3 webhook migration from Calling (operator tooling). Permission `developer-platform.administer` (operator console only) and a named human operator. The delivery switch. Refused (409 INVALID_STATE) unless this platform delivers (DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_WEBHOOK_DELIVERY_MODE=active), Calling stopped sending (CALLING_WEBHOOK_DELIVERY_ENABLED=false, no live claim) and the last completed import started after that. Releases the held mirrors of Calling's open deliveries (same delivery and event ids, attempts continued), de-duplicates every logical delivery to exactly one sender and moves to CUT_OVER (deliveries to migrated subscriptions are sent only from then on). Audited.

post.description: Section 53 §9.1 / §19.3 webhook migration from Calling (operator tooling). Permission `developer-platform.administer` (operator console only) and a named human operator. Rolls the delivery switch back: refused unless the phase is CUT_OVER / ROLLED_BACK and Calling's delivery is still disabled; moves to ROLLED_BACK (nothing is sent here any more; refused while a claim here is live), settles at Calling every open delivery already delivered here and hands every other open delivery back to Calling. Deliveries of events Calling never recorded are reported as orphans (the rollback stops unless acceptOrphans). Audited.
